Update, October 7: Apple has now released two RC builds to public beta users. The internal build numbers are the same as the developer RC.

In addition to releasing the second public beta of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate, Apple is also now rolling out the first release candidate (RC) of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2. Details below.

Security updates continue for older macOS versions

In line with the usual practice of small updates for older macOS versions, Apple today directly rolled out the first release candidates of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2, without first releasing a regular beta beforehand.

Apple released macOS Sequoia 15.8.1 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 at the end of last month, and both versions went through two RCs before being officially released.

Apple's release notes for the first RC of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 only mention that they "provide important security fixes and are recommended for all users." Last month's update included a CoreGraphics security fix, with details as follows:

Apple is expected to disclose the fixes included in macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 only after they are officially released, with the final versions most likely launching in the coming weeks alongside macOS 27.2 Golden Gate.

The release build of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 RC 1 is 24H219, while the release build of macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 RC 1 is 25G320.

If you spot anything new or different in today's RCs, feel free to let us know in the comments section.
